city.Brunei.description: This small, wealthy sultanate sits on the jungle island of Borneo in Southeast Asia. It is famous for its enormous royal palace, thick tropical rainforests, and a floating village of stilt houses built over the water.
city.Brunei.landmark: golden-domed Sultan Omar Ali Saifuddien Mosque reflected in its lagoon at dusk
city.Brunei.greeting: In Malay, hello is “Helo” (HEH-loh), and “Apa khabar” (AH-pah KAH-bar) means how are you.

city.Cyprus.description: This sunny island in the eastern Mediterranean is the sea's third-largest. Greek myth calls it the birthplace of Aphrodite, goddess of love, and its very name is linked to copper, a metal mined here since ancient times.
city.Cyprus.landmark: Aphrodite's Rock rising from the turquoise sea along the rocky coast
city.Cyprus.flag: traced a flag: white with a copper-colored island shape and two green olive branches below it
city.Cyprus.clue.0: booked a ferry toward a sunny island out in the eastern Mediterranean Sea
city.Cyprus.clue.1: kept talking about an old legend that a goddess of love was born from the sea foam here
city.Georgia.description: This mountainous country in the Caucasus, where Europe meets Asia, is famous for making wine in giant clay pots buried underground, cave cities carved into cliffs, and steamy hot springs.
city.Georgia.landmark: lone Gergeti Trinity Church on a green hill beneath snow-capped Mount Kazbek
city.Georgia.flag: a white banner with one big red cross and four little red crosses
city.Georgia.clue.0: studied a map of a small country tucked in the Caucasus mountains between Europe and Asia
city.Georgia.clue.1: kept talking about wine made the old way, aged underground in huge buried clay pots
city.Iran.description: This large country in the Middle East was the heart of the ancient Persian Empire, and today is famous for grand palace ruins, sparkling tiled mosques, and desert towns cooled by tall wind towers.
city.Iran.landmark: turquoise-tiled dome and minarets of the Shah Mosque on Naqsh-e Jahan Square

city.Kazakhstan.description: This vast country in Central Asia is the largest land in the world with no coast — endless grassy plains dotted with a brand-new capital of gleaming towers, and home to the launch site of the first human in space.
city.Kazakhstan.greeting: People speak Kazakh — say hello with “Salem” (sah-LEM).
